blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Misogyny is among the most prevalent forms of online hate speech directed at Brazilian users, yet open and auditable resources dedicated to it in Brazilian Portuguese remain scarce. We introduce MISO-BR, an open, documented and versioned corpus of 896 balanced social media texts annotated for binary misogyny, released with its construction protocol and reproducible baselines. The corpus combines lexicon- and target-guided scraping from X with items imported from OLID-BR, a large language model triage stage whose prompt and decoding parameters are released, and manual annotation by three annotators following a written guide. Inter-annotator reliability reaches a Fleiss' kappa of 0.788 over 816 items. Under a single fixed protocol we compare four classical classifiers (Multinomial and Bernoulli Naive Bayes, a linear SVM and a random forest) with fine-tuned BERTimbau Base and Large. The classical models cluster between 0.651 and 0.676 macro-F1 and are precision-oriented but recall-poor. The transformers reach 0.833 macro-F1 and accuracy (Wilson 95% CI for accuracy [0.77, 0.88]), a gap of roughly 16 points, while Base and Large are indistinguishable on the test set despite a 2.6x difference in training cost. We argue that the value of the resource lies less in its headline scores than in the auditability of its pipeline, and we state three limits that users must reckon with: the artificial class balance, whose effect on precision under realistic prevalence we quantify; the association between provenance and label, which the released source field makes measurable; and the selection bias induced by lexicon-guided sampling and automatic triage. The corpus, annotation guide, models and experimental scripts are publicly available.
blocks.zh: Misogyny是最普遍的针对巴西用户的网上仇恨言论形式之一,然而,用巴西葡萄牙语提供的公开和可审计的资源仍然稀缺。 我们介绍MISO-BR, 由896种平衡的社交媒体文本组成的公开的、有记录的和版本的, 书目将从X取出词典和目标指南的刮取与从OLID-BR取出的物品结合起来,OLID-BR是一个大型语言模型分解阶段,其即时解码参数被发布,三位注释员根据书面指南进行人工注释。 通知人之间的可靠性在816件物品上达到Fleiss的0.788卡帕. 根据单一的固定协议,我们将四个古典分类器(多管和伯努利纳伊夫·贝耶斯、一线性SVM和一线性森林)与经过微调的BERTimbau Base和Lige进行比较。 古典模型集群介于0.651到0.676个宏-F1之间,具有精度导向但召回-差. 变压器达到0.833个宏-F1和精度(Wilson 95% CI的精度为[0.77,0.88]),相差约16分,而Base and Large虽然在培训成本上存在2.6x相差,但在测试集上却无法区分. 我们辩称,资源的价值与其说在于其头条分数,不如说在于其管道的可审计性。 我们指出,用户必须考虑三个限制:人为的类别平衡,我们在现实流行情况下对精确性的影响;来源和标签之间的联系,释放源域使这种联系可以衡量;以及由词汇指导的抽样和自动分类引起的选择偏差。 教程、注释指南、模型和实验脚本均可公开查阅。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Two decades of expansion of social platforms have reorganised public discourse, and with it the distribution of who can speak and at what cost. Alongside the widening of participation, the same infrastructure has industrialised the circulation of hostility toward groups that were already marginalised offline, a phenomenon that has become one of the central preoccupations of both civil society and computational linguistics ( Fortuna and Nunes, 2018 ; Poletto et al., 2021 ) . Gendered hostility occupies a distinctive place in this landscape. It is not simply hate speech that happens to have a woman as its object; it is a discursive mode with its own repertoire, its own justificatory grammar, and its own tendency to attack the speaker’s legitimacy rather than her argument.
blocks.zh: 20年的社交平台扩张重组了公共言论,并以此来分配谁能说话以及付出什么代价. 除了参与的扩大外,同样的基础设施还使对已经处于边缘地位的群体的敌意流出,这一现象已成为民间社会和计算语言学的核心关注之一(Fortuna and Nunes,2018;Poletto等人,2021年)。 性别敌意在这一地貌中占有显著地位。 以女性为对象的仇恨言论并不仅仅是简单的仇恨言论,而是带有自身内容、自身正当性语法和攻击演讲者合法性而非她论点的偏执模式。

blocks.en: The Brazilian case is well documented and severe. The MonitorA reports show that digital environments reproduce and intensify patterns of discrimination present offline, and that women in positions of public visibility, journalists, politicians, researchers and athletes, face attacks that route around their ideas and target their gender ( InternetLab and Revista AzMina, 2024 ) . SaferNet Brasil received 23,947 reports of online hate speech in the first half of 2022, an increase of roughly 67.5 % 67.5\% over the same period of the previous year, and misogyny was the most reported category in absolute terms, with 7,096 reports ( SaferNet Brasil, 2022 ) . Volume, however, understates the problem. A substantial share of misogynistic speech travels in a jocular, sarcastic or ironic register, in which the offence is carried by presupposition rather than by any single lexical item, and it is precisely this share that automatic systems handle worst.
blocks.zh: 巴西的案件有详细记录,情节严重。 " 监测者 " 组织的报告显示,数字环境在线下复制并强化了歧视模式,在公众知名度职位上的妇女、记者、政治家、研究人员和运动员面临围绕其思想和针对其性别的攻击(InternetLab和Revista Azmina, 2024年)。 SaferNet Brasil在2022上半年收到23,947起网上仇恨言论报告,比上一年同期增加约67.5% 67.5%;而反女性是报告最多的绝对类别,有7,096起报告(SaferNet Brasil, 2022). 然而,数量低估了这个问题。 相当一部分的厌恶女性的言论在慢跑、讽刺或有讽刺意味的登记册中进行,在登记册中,犯罪是由预先假定而不是由任何单一的词汇项目进行的,而自动系统处理最坏的正是这一份额。

blocks.en: Progress on automatic detection is bounded by the resources available, and here Brazilian Portuguese occupies an awkward position. It is not a low-resource language in the usual sense, and it is not well served either. A sequence of corpora has established a foundation for offensive and hateful language in the language, from OffComBR ( Pelle and Moreira, 2017 ) through the hierarchically labelled dataset of Fortuna et al. (2019) , ToLD-Br ( Leite et al., 2020 ) , HateBR ( Vargas et al., 2022 ) , OLID-BR ( Trajano et al., 2023 ) and TuPy-E ( Oliveira et al., 2023 ) . Almost all of them are generalist. Where gender appears, it appears as one category among many, usually labelled sexism , defined within a schema whose primary axis is offensiveness rather than gender, and annotated by people whose instructions were written for the general case. ToLD-Br does carry an explicit misogyny label, but only 29 instances reached consensus among its three annotators, which is a count that supports an observation rather than an experiment. The first Brazilian corpus built specifically around hate speech against women, MINA-BR ( Plath et al., 2022 ) , was described in 2022, but its data were published in the research data repository of Unicamp only in March 2025 ( Plath et al., 2025 ) , with publicly downloadable files and no stated licence, and independent work on it has only recently begun to appear ( Vicente et al., 2025 ) . A more recent effort pairs a misogyny lexicon, LexMis-BR, with lexicon-guided collection and human annotation ( Rangel et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 自动检测的进展受现有资源的限制,巴西葡萄牙人在此地处于尴尬的境地。 它不是通常意义上的低资源语言,它也没有得到很好的服务。 从OffComBR(Pelle and Moreira, 2017年)到Fortuna等(2019年),TOLD-Br(Leite等, 2020年),HateBR的分级数据集, (Vargas等,2022年),OLID-BR (Trajano等,2023年)和TuPy-E (Oliveira等,2023年). 几乎所有的都是通论者. 在出现性别时,它似乎属于许多类别,通常称为性别主义,它被定义为一个主要轴心是攻击性而不是性别的计划,并由那些为一般案例写出指示的人加以说明。 TOLD-Br确实带有明显的厌恶女性的标签,但只有29个实例在它的3个注释者之间达成共识,这是一个支持观察而不是实验的计数. 2022年对巴西第一部专门针对对妇女仇恨言论的人身保护令(MINA-BR (Plath等,2022年))进行了描述,但其数据直到2025年3月才被公布在Unicamp的研究资料库(Plath等,2025年),档案可以公开下载,没有说明许可证,而且有关该人身保护令的独立工作最近才开始(Vicente等,2025年)。 最近的一项努力是将LexMis-BR的反女性词典与由词典指导的集合和人类注释(Rangel等,2026年)。

blocks.en: The consequence is a field in which specialised resources are only beginning to become inspectable. Until March 2025 the most direct antecedent to new work on Brazilian misogyny detection had not been publicly deposited, and the specialised resources that now exist differ in what they label, hate and offensiveness in the case of MINA-BR rather than misogyny as distinct from non-gendered toxicity, and in how much of their construction they expose. This is not a criticism of those efforts, whose contributions stand, but it is a structural problem: without open specialised resources whose pipelines can be audited there is no shared object against which annotation schemes can be argued about, no benchmark against which modelling claims can be checked, and no way to distinguish a genuine advance from a favourable test split.
blocks.zh: 结果,专门资源才开始可以检查的领域。 直到2025年3月,巴西对丑恶女性的检测新工作最直接的先例仍未公开交存,目前存在的专门资源在对MINA-BR的描述、仇恨和冒犯性方面有所不同,而不是在与非性别毒性不同的丑恶女性,以及它们暴露的构造中有多少。 这不是对这些努力的批评,而是一个结构性问题:没有开放的专门资源,其管道可以审计,就没有共同的目标,无法对说明计划进行论证,也没有标准可以检查建模索赔,也无法区分真正的进步和有利的试验分化。

blocks.en: This paper contributes MISO-BR, an open corpus for binary misogyny detection in Brazilian Portuguese, released with its annotation guide, its data dictionary, its licence, its versioning and its baselines. The corpus comprises 896 instances and rests its claim to relevance on three properties. First, it is specialised: every annotation decision was made under a definition of misogyny, not under a definition of offensiveness with a gender attribute attached. Second, it is auditable end to end, since the scraping strategy, the lexicons, the triage prompt and its decoding parameters, the annotator profiles, the disagreement cases, the resolution rule and the provenance of every instance are all documented and, where applicable, released. Third, its numbers are reported together with their limits. We report confidence intervals alongside point estimates, we do not rank models whose differences amount to four test items, we do not draw the cross-corpus comparison that the reported literature invites, and we quantify the degradation of precision that follows from evaluating a balanced corpus and deploying against a skewed stream.
blocks.zh: 本文提供MISO-BR,是巴西葡萄牙语二进制反女性检测的公开程序,发布时附有注释指南、数据词典、许可证、版本和基线。 人身保护令共有896个案例,它声称与三个财产有关。 首先,它具有专门性:每个注释决定都是根据厌恶女性的定义作出的,而不是根据带有性别属性的冒犯性定义作出的。 第二,可以审计的结局是结束,因为报废战略、词汇、分类提示及其解码参数、注释人简介、分歧案件、解决规则和每个实例的出处都记录在案,并酌情予以公布。 第三,报告数字及其限度。 我们报告信任间隔和点数估计,我们不划分其差异为4个测试项目的模型,我们不进行所报告文献所邀请的跨公司比较,我们量化了评估平衡因素和对照扭曲流部署所产生的精度退化。

blocks.en: Alongside the corpus we contribute a benchmark evaluation designed to establish what it supports. Six models are compared under one fixed protocol and one fixed partition, spanning the two paradigms against which the Brazilian literature has reported: four classical classifiers built on bag-of-words and TF-IDF representations, and two fine-tuned BERTimbau variants. The comparison is informative in both directions. It establishes the baselines a successor system must beat, and it locates where the difficulty of the task actually sits, since the classical models plateau at a recall near 0.60 0.60 , while the transformers recover a substantially larger share of the positives, for a difference of roughly 16 16 macro- F 1 F_{1} points. The evaluation also settles a practical question of scale, in that the additional capacity of BERTimbau Large yields no measurable gain over Base for 2.6 × 2.6\times the training cost.
blocks.zh: 除了这项调查之外,我们还提供了一项基准评估,旨在确定它支持什么。 六个模型在一个固定协议和一个固定分区下进行比较,跨越了巴西文献报告的两个范式:四个以字袋和TF-IDF表示为基础的古典分类器,以及两个微调的BERTIMBAU变体. 这一比较在两个方面都提供了信息。 它确定了一个必须击败的后继系统的基线,它定位了任务难度的实际位置,因为古典模型高地在召回地接近0.60.0.60分,而变压器则恢复了相当大一部分正数,相差约16个宏观-F 1-F-QQ1}分. 评价还解决了一个实际的规模问题,因为增加BERTIMBAU LOG的能力不能使培训费用比Base增加2.6x2.6倍。

blocks.en: The remainder of the paper is organised as follows. Section 2 situates MISO-BR in the international and Brazilian literature. Section 3 describes the construction pipeline and characterises the resulting corpus. Section 4 presents the experimental protocol, and Section 5 reports the results together with the qualifications they carry. Section 6 states what the corpus cannot support, and Section 7 concludes.
blocks.zh: 本文件的其余部分如下: 第2节将MISO-BR列入国际和巴西文献。 第3节描述了施工管道,并说明了由此而来的程序。 第4节介绍实验协议,第5节报告结果及其附带的条件。 第6节说明了本文书不能支持的内容,第7节得出结论。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: The international literature separated misogyny from general abuse relatively early. The Automatic Misogyny Identification tasks at IberEval and EVALITA established the first shared evaluations dedicated to the phenomenon, with schemas that distinguished categories such as stereotype, dominance, derailing, sexual harassment and discredit, and that separated the misogyny judgement from the question of whether the target was an individual or women as a group ( Fersini et al., 2018b ; Fersini et al., 2018a ) . The later MAMI task extended the problem to multimodal content, acknowledging that a large share of contemporary misogynistic circulation is memetic rather than textual ( Fersini et al., 2022 ) .
blocks.zh: 国际文献将厌恶女性与一般虐待区分开来相对较早。 在IberEval和EVALITA的自动误差识别任务建立了第一个专门针对这一现象的共享评价,其计划区分了陈规定型观念、支配地位、出轨、性骚扰和失信等类别,并将误差判断与目标是否是个人或妇女作为一个群体的问题区分开来(Fersini等,2018b;Fersini等,2018a). 后来的MAMI任务将问题扩大到了多模式内容,承认当代的厌恶女性的流通中很大一部分是memetic而不是文字上(Fersini等,2022.).

blocks.en: Two subsequent contributions are directly relevant to the methodological posture we adopt. Guest et al. (2021) built an expert-annotated English dataset with a hierarchical taxonomy of online misogyny and, crucially, reported that the phenomenon is rare enough in unfiltered data that meaningful corpora require deliberate sampling, which in turn distorts the resulting prevalence in ways that must be declared. Zeinert et al. (2021) made the annotation process itself the object of study for Danish, showing that the reliability of misogyny annotation depends heavily on how the guideline handles context, ambiguity and reclaimed slurs, and that a single aggregate κ \kappa conceals systematic differences between annotator subgroups. Both findings inform how we present agreement in Section 3 .
blocks.zh: 随后的两项贡献与我们采取的方法态势直接相关。 来宾等. (2021年) 搭建了附有专家说明的英文数据集,其分类系统具有在线厌恶女性的分级性,关键是报告称,这种现象在未过滤的数据中已经足够罕见,有意义的蝎子需要经过深思熟虑的取样,这反过来又以必须申报的方式扭曲了由此产生的流行率. Zeinert等人(2021年)将注释过程本身作为丹麦人的研究对象,表明厌恶女性注释的可靠性很大程度上取决于准则如何处理上下文,模棱两可并还原出浆液,单一的集合κ\kappa掩盖了注释者分组之间的系统差异. 两个结论都说明我们如何在第3节中表示同意。

blocks.en: The broader abusive language literature has converged on a set of cautions that any new resource must answer. Wiegand et al. (2019) showed that datasets built by keyword sampling produce classifiers whose apparent accuracy partly reflects the sampling procedure rather than the phenomenon. Sap et al. (2019) showed that annotation of toxicity can encode dialectal bias, penalising varieties whose speakers are already disadvantaged. Vidgen and Derczynski (2020) surveyed training data across the field and found under-documentation to be the norm. Röttger et al. (2021) argued that aggregate scores on a held-out split systematically overstate model competence, and proposed functional testing as a complement. Bender and Friedman (2018) and Gebru et al. (2021) formalised the documentation obligations that follow. We treat these as constraints on what a corpus paper may claim.
blocks.zh: 更广泛的滥用性语言文献集中了一套警告,即任何新的资源都必须回答。 Wiegand等人(2019年)表明,由关键词取样所构建的数据集产生了分类器,其表面准确性部分反映了取样程序而不是现象. Sap等人(2019年)表明,对毒性的注释可以编码出方言偏差,惩罚那些说话者已经处于不利地位的品种。 Vidgen和Derczynski(2020年)调查了全场的培训数据,发现文件不足是常态. Röttger等人(2021年)认为,对被搁置的分散式系统多报模型能力的总分,并提议将功能测试作为补充. Bender和Friedman(2018年)以及Gebru等人(2021年)将随后的文件义务正式化. 我们把这些当作对诉讼文书可能主张的限制。

The foundation phase produced small, exploratory corpora: OffComBR ( Pelle and Moreira, 2017 ) with 1,250 comments from the G1 news portal, framed as binary offensiveness with auxiliary type labels and baselines of F F -measure 0.80 0.80 for SVM and 0.75 0.75 for Naive Bayes; and the dataset of Fortuna et al. (2019) with 5,668 tweets in European and Brazilian Portuguese under a binary label plus a hierarchical multilabel schema, with an LSTM baseline at F 1 = 0.78 F_{1}=0.78 .

blocks.en: The expansion phase increased volume and platform diversity. ToLD-Br ( Leite et al., 2020 ) contributed roughly 21,000 tweets across seven categories, releasing both individual annotations and consensus levels, with a binary toxic versus non-toxic baseline of macro- F 1 = 0.76 F_{1}=0.76 . HateBR ( Vargas et al., 2022 ) contributed 7,000 expert-annotated Instagram comments from the profiles of Brazilian politicians across nine hate groups, reporting F 1 = 0.85 F_{1}=0.85 for offensive language and F 1 = 0.78 F_{1}=0.78 for hate speech. OLID-BR ( Trajano et al., 2023 ) imported the OLID schema ( Zampieri et al., 2019 ) into Portuguese, covering offensiveness, type, target and toxic spans over 6,354 comments later expanded to 13,538, with F 1 = 0.85 F_{1}=0.85 on offensiveness and F 1 = 0.72 F_{1}=0.72 on toxicity type. TuPy-E ( Oliveira et al., 2023 ) compiled Fortuna et al. (2019) , Leite et al. (2020) and Vargas et al. (2022) and added new annotations, reaching 43,668 instances and a binary F 1 = 0.90 F_{1}=0.90 .

HateBR(Vargas等,2022年)提供了来自巴西9个仇恨团体的政治家简介的7,000个专家附加的Instagram评论,报告F 1 = 0.85 F_{1}=0.85为攻击性语言,F 1 = 0.78 F_{1}=0.78为仇恨言论. OLID-BR(Trajano等,2023年)将OLID schema(Zampieri等,2019年)进口到葡萄牙文中,涵盖攻击性,类型,目标及毒性跨度超过6,354个评论后被扩展至13,538个,其中F 1=0.85 F_{1}=0.85为攻击性,F 1=0.72为毒性类型. TuPy-E (Oliveira等,2023年)编纂了"福尔图纳等" (2019年),"莱特等" (2020年)和"巴尔加斯等" (2022年)并添加了新的说明,达到43,668例并有二进制F 1 = 0.90 F_{1}=0.90.

blocks.en: The specialisation phase is recent and thin. MINA-BR ( Plath et al., 2022 ) was built from X and YouTube expressly to identify hate speech against women, and reported an SVM baseline of F 1 = 0.57 F_{1}=0.57 . It is the closest antecedent to the present work. Its data were published in the research data repository of Unicamp in March 2025 ( Plath et al., 2025 ) : 6,002 collected comments, of which 2,091 were labelled by three annotators each for hate and for offensiveness, together with annotator profiles and self-rated confidence. The files are publicly downloadable, although the record states no licence and asks users to contact the depositor before use. A first independent study has since used them ( Vicente et al., 2025 ) . Rangel et al. (2026) propose the LexMis-BR lexicon and use it to guide the collection and annotation of social media messages, releasing the artefacts that platform rules and ethical constraints permit. MISO-BR differs from both in its label definition, which separates misogyny from non-gendered toxicity, and in what accompanies the data: the triage prompt, the annotation guide, per-instance provenance, fixed partitions and a versioned release.
blocks.zh: 特化阶段为近代并薄. MINA-BR(Plath等,2022年)是从X和YouTube建造的,明确识别针对妇女的仇恨言论,并报告SVM基线为F 1=0.57 F_{1}=0.57. 这是与目前工作最相近的前作。 其数据于2025年3月在Unicamp的研究数据库(Plath等,2025年)上公布:收集了6,002条评论,其中2,091条被3名注释者分别贴上仇恨和冒犯性的标签,加上注释者简介和自评自信. 这些文件可以公开下载,尽管记录没有说明许可证,并要求用户在使用前与储户联系. 此后,首次独立研究采用了这些方法(Vicente等,2025年)。 Rangel等人(2026年)提出"LexMis-BR词汇"(LexMis-BR lexicon),并用它来指导社交媒体信息的收集和注释,释放出平台规则和道德约束允许的手工艺品. MISO-BR与其标签定义不同,标签定义将厌恶女性与非性别毒性区分开来,以及数据随附的内容:分解提示,注解指南,逐出出处,固定分区和版本放出.

blocks.zh: 表1:巴西葡萄牙蝎子与厌恶女性的检测有关。 “Misogyny”表示这一计划是直接地、间接地通过更广泛的性别主义类别解决这种现象,还是根本不解决。 * 收集的评论,其中2 091个有标签。

blocks.en: The gap is therefore specific rather than general. Brazilian Portuguese does not lack hate speech data; it has few open resources in which misogyny is the object of annotation rather than a facet of it, and those that exist are recent. MISO-BR does not close the volume gap. It narrows the availability gap for the specialised case, and it does so with the documentation that would allow a larger successor to be built on compatible foundations.
blocks.zh: 因此,差距是具体的,而不是普遍的。 巴西葡萄牙语并不缺乏仇恨言论数据;它几乎没有公开资源,其中厌恶女性是其注释的对象,而不是其表面,而现存的则是最近才出现的. MISO-BR没有缩小体积差距. 它缩小了专门案件的可获性差距,并用能够使更大的继任者建立在相容基础上的文件加以弥补。

blocks.en: 3 The MISO-BR Corpus
blocks.zh: 3 MISO-BR公司

blocks.en: This section describes how MISO-BR was built and what the result looks like. The construction pipeline has four stages, targeted collection, automatic triage, manual annotation, and consolidation with release, and Section 3.4 then characterises the corpus that emerges from them. Table 2 reports the item counts at each stage, which we present as a funnel because every reduction is a decision with consequences for what the corpus can be used to measure.
blocks.zh: 本节介绍MISO-BR的构建方式以及结果的外观. 施工管道分为四个阶段,即定向收集、自动分解、人工注释和释放后合并,然后第3.4节对从中产生的实体进行定性。 表2报告项目在每个阶段的清点情况,我们将其作为一个漏斗,因为每次减少都是一项决定,其后果是可以用来衡量的。

blocks.en: 3.1 Collection and Triage
blocks.zh: 3.1 收藏和曲折

blocks.en: X was selected as the primary source for its microblogging format, which favours condensed and highly opinionated discourse and has repeatedly proven productive for studies of gendered abuse ( Waseem and Hovy, 2016 ; Zampieri et al., 2019 ) . Since March 2023 the platform has charged for basic API access, which placed programmatic collection outside the budget of the project; collection was therefore performed by scraping, implemented in Python with the Twikit library. URLs and line breaks were removed at collection time, duplicates were eliminated, and randomised pauses of one to three seconds were inserted between requests after the collecting account encountered temporary blocks.
blocks.zh: X被选为其微博格式的主要出处,该格式倾向于收敛和高度有观点的言论,并被反复证明对性别虐待的研究是有成效的(Waseem and Hovy, 2016; Zampieri等, 2019). 2023年3月起,该平台开始收取基本API访问费,将程序集置于项目预算之外;因此通过刮取来进行收集,由Twikit库在Python实施. 收集时删除了URL和换行符,消除了重复,并在收集账户遇到临时块后,在请求之间随机地插入一至三秒的暂停.

blocks.en: Sampling followed the target-guided strategy of Waseem and Hovy (2016) , combining observation of high-visibility profiles, journalists, artists and digital influencers, with lexicons of terms associated with misogyny and sexism drawn from MonitorA ( InternetLab and Revista AzMina, 2024 ) . The lexicon was organised along three complementary axes. The first comprises direct offensive and discriminatory terms recurrent in attacks on women, a vocabulary attested in MINA-BR ( Plath et al., 2022 ) and in systematic reviews of hate speech resources ( Poletto et al., 2021 ) . The second comprises identity and social group markers relating to gender, race, regional origin and political alignment, following the observation in HateBR ( Vargas et al., 2022 ) that such categories capture the intersection of misogyny with other axes of hostility. The third comprises social and behavioural context terms tied to gender roles and sexist stereotypes, a dimension emphasised by Mantini et al. (2021) in showing that violent narratives can be constructed without any explicit slur. This procedure yielded 614 comments. To broaden coverage, 461 additional items were imported from the training split of OLID-BR ( Trajano et al., 2023 ) , drawing on the sexism and not offensive categories, the former to reinforce the positive class and the latter the negative. Imported items were re-annotated under the MISO-BR guide rather than inherited, so that every label in the corpus reflects a decision made under a misogyny-specific definition; the original OLID-BR label is preserved in the label_source field for auditability.
blocks.zh: 采样遵循Waseem和Hovy的目标指导战略(2016年),将观察高能见度简介、记者、艺术家和数字影响者与MonitorA(InternetLab和Revista Azmina,2024年)中与厌恶和性别歧视有关的术语词汇结合起来。 词汇是按照三个互补轴来编排的。 第一部分包括攻击妇女时反复出现的直接攻击性和歧视性用语,在MINA-BR(Plath等人,2022年)和对仇恨言论资源的系统审查(Poletto等人,2021年)中都有证明。 第二类包括身份标志和社会群体标志,涉及性别、种族、地区出身和政治协调,此前在HateBR(Vargas等,2022年)中曾指出,这类标志涉及厌恶女性与其他敌对轴心的交叉。 第三个方面是与性别角色和性别陈规定型观念相关的社会和行为背景术语,Mantini等人(2021年)强调这一方面,表明暴力叙事可以在没有任何明显污点的情况下构建。 这一程序产生了614条意见。 为了扩大覆盖范围,从OLID-BR(Trajano等,2023年)的训练分出中又进口了461个物品,这些物品借鉴了性别歧视而不是攻击性类别,前者用于加强正类,后者用于否定类。 进口物品在MISO-BR指南下重新附加了说明,而不是继承,因此,本书中的每一个标签都反映了根据反女性特定定义作出的决定;原OLID-BR标签保存在标签-源字段中,以便审计。

blocks.en: We state plainly what this sampling strategy does and does not deliver. It does not approximate the natural distribution of discourse on the platform, and no statistic computed on MISO-BR should be read as an estimate of the prevalence of misogyny on X. What it delivers is a sufficiently varied set of positive instances to support annotation and model development, at the known cost identified by Wiegand et al. (2019) : classifiers trained on keyword-sampled data partly learn the sampling procedure.
blocks.zh: 我们清楚地指出,这种取样战略能够和不能产生什么效果。 它与平台上言论的自然分布不相近,对MISO-BR的任何统计都不应被理解为X上厌恶女性的流行程度的估计. 它提供的一系列正面实例足以支持注释和模型开发,其成本由Wiegand等人(2019年)确定:按关键词抽样数据培训的分类人员部分了解取样程序。

blocks.en: Manual annotation is the binding constraint on corpus size, and the density of relevant material in target-guided scraping is still low enough that annotators spend most of their effort on items that will be discarded. We therefore inserted an automatic triage stage using gemini-2.5-flash , following the practice of documenting thresholds and prioritisation decisions explicitly ( Trajano et al., 2023 ; Poletto et al., 2021 ) . The model classified each of the 614 collected comments as Neutral , Toxic or Misogynistic , and all items in the latter two categories, 355 in total, were forwarded to human annotation. Decoding used a temperature of 0.08 0.08 , top_p of 0.8 0.8 , top_k of 40 40 and enforced JSON output.
blocks.zh: 人工注释是对实体大小的约束性限制,而目标制导的刮取中相关材料的密度仍然很低,以至于注释者将其大部分精力花在将要丢弃的物品上. 因此,我们按照明确记录阈值和确定优先顺序决定的做法(Trajano等人,2023年;Poletto等人,2021年),插入了使用遗传学-2.5-斜线的自动分辨阶段。 该模型将所收集的614个评论中每个评论都归类为中立、有毒或误入歧途,后两类的所有物品,共355个,都转交给了人类注释。 解码使用温度为0.08 0.08,上_p为0.8 0.8,上_k为40并强制JSON输出.

blocks.en: The prompt was structured as a staged decision procedure rather than a category list, and this design deserves comment because it is the part of the pipeline most likely to be reused. A preliminary step asked the model to establish the overall sentiment and to check for resignified usage, the case in which a term with strong offensive potential functions as an intense vocative inside a community, as in exchanges between fans and artists, and to route such cases to Neutral regardless of surface lexis. Only if the intent was hostile did the procedure ask whether the text was intrinsically offensive, then whether the target was a woman or the feminine in general, and finally whether the offence was motivated by gender stereotype rather than being a personal attack that happened to land on a woman. This last distinction is the one that separates Misogynistic from Toxic and is the conceptual centre of the whole resource. The complete prompt is released with the corpus.
blocks.zh: 该提示是作为分阶段决定程序而不是类别清单编排的,这一设计值得评论,因为它是管道中最有可能被再利用的部分. 一个初步步骤要求该模式确定总体情绪并检查辞职的用法,在这种情况下,一个具有强烈攻击性潜在功能的名词在社区内具有强烈的煽动性,如在粉丝和艺术家之间的交流中,并将此类案件提交中立人,而不论表面法则如何。 只有在意图敌对的情况下,该程序才询问该案文是否本质上是冒犯性的,然后是针对妇女还是针对一般妇女,最后,犯罪是否出于性别陈规定型观念,而不是发生在妇女身上的人身攻击。 最后的区别是将误入歧途与有毒区别开来,是整个资源的概念中心. 完整的提示 与程序书一起释放。

blocks.en: The triage is efficient and it is also a source of bias. A model of this kind may under-represent subtle, ironic or coded misogyny relative to explicit forms, and may inherit associations between dialectal features and toxicity of the sort documented by Sap et al. (2019) . Two mitigations were applied and a third is owed. Human annotation under a written guide governs every retained label, so triage cannot create a positive instance on its own. Borderline cases were reviewed. What has not been done, and what we recommend to anyone extending the corpus, is an audit of a random sample of the 259 discarded items to estimate the false negative rate of the triage stage. Without it, the recall of the pipeline with respect to the collected pool is unknown, and we do not claim otherwise.
blocks.zh: 分化效率高,也是偏见的根源. 这类模型相对于显性形式可能代表了微妙的,讽刺的或被编码的厌恶女性,并可能继承了由Sap等人(2019年)所记载的方言特征和毒性之间的关联. 采取了两项缓解措施,并欠了第三项措施。 书面指南下的人类注释规范了每个被保留的标签,因此分解本身不能产生正实例. 对边界线案件进行了审查。 还没有做的事情,以及我们向任何扩大调查对象提出的建议,是对259个被丢弃物品的随机抽样审计,以估计分类阶段的虚假负率。 没有它,就收集的水池而言,对输油管的召回是未知的,我们没有提出相反的说法。

blocks.en: 3.2 Annotation and Agreement
blocks.zh: 3.2 说明和协定

blocks.en: Annotation was governed by a written guide developed for this corpus, containing operational criteria, worked examples, counter-examples, screenshots of the tool and a decision flowchart mirroring the three-step procedure used in triage. The guide is published alongside the corpus. Three non-specialist annotators participated: the first author, aged 44, university graduate; a male volunteer, aged 31, university graduate; and a female volunteer, aged 31, a fourth-semester undergraduate in systems development. Before annotation began, all three were trained on the tool and given an orientation session covering the concepts of misogyny, sexism and machismo, with time for questions. We report annotator composition in this detail because, as Zeinert et al. (2021) demonstrate, the identity and training of annotators is part of the definition of a misogyny corpus rather than a footnote to it, and because a panel of three, only one of whom is a woman, is a real limitation rather than a formality.
blocks.zh: 说明由为本文书编写的书面指南加以规范,其中载有操作标准、工作实例、反实例、工具截图以及反映分门别类使用的三步程序的决定流程图。 指南与文书一并出版。 3名非专家的注释员参加了讲习班:第1名作者,44岁,大学毕业;1名男性志愿者,31岁,大学毕业;1名女性志愿者,31岁,四年级本科生,系统开发。 在开始注解前,这三人都接受了关于工具的培训,并接受了一个涵盖厌恶女性,性别主义和大男子主义等概念的定向课程,并有时间提问. 我们详细报告注释员的组成情况,因为正如Zeinert等人(2021年)所证明的,注释员的身份和培训是污辱性主体定义的一部分,而不是其脚注,而且一个三人小组(其中只有一个是妇女)是一个真正的限制,而不是一种形式。

blocks.en: The label set had three values. Neutral covers comments without offensive or prejudicial charge. Toxic covers offensive or aggressive comments not specifically directed at women. Misogynistic covers hostile comments, explicit or implicit, motivated by the feminine gender. The released corpus collapses this into the binary task by mapping Misogynistic to 1 1 and both other categories to 0 0 ; the three-way distinction survives in the guide and is recoverable for future multiclass work. Annotation was performed in Label Studio.
blocks.zh: 标签集有三个值。 中立性包括评论,没有冒犯性或有偏见的指控。 毒药包括攻击性或攻击性的评论,而不是专门针对妇女的评论。 女性偏执包括出于女性动机的明显或含蓄的敌对言论。 释放的活体通过将Misogynistic绘制到1 1 和将其他类别都绘制到0 0 来将它倒入二进制任务;三向区分在指南中存在,并且可以在未来的多类工作中被恢复. 在Label工作室进行了注释。

blocks.en: Reliability was assessed with Fleiss’ κ \kappa ( Fleiss, 1971 ) , appropriate for multiple annotators over nominal categories. On the decisive question, whether a text is misogynistic, over N = 816 N=816 items with two categories and three raters, the coefficient reached κ = 0.7880 \kappa=0.7880 , with observed agreement of 0.8946 0.8946 and chance agreement of 0.5029 0.5029 . On the scale of Landis and Koch (1977) this falls in the substantial band ( 0.61 ≤ κ ≤ 0.80 0.61\leq\kappa\leq 0.80 ), close to its upper boundary. Unanimity was reached on 687 items ( 84.2 % 84.2\% ), with disagreement on 129 ( 15.8 % 15.8\% ).
blocks.zh: 可靠性是用Fleiss的o-kappa(Fleiss,1971年)来评估的,适合多个标注者,而不是名义类别。 关于决定性的问题,一出文字是否为反女性,超过N=816 N=816项,有两类和三种评分,系数为0.7880\kappa=0.7880,观测到的协议为0.89460.8946,概率协议为0.50290.5029. 在Landis和Koch(1977年)的尺度上,这降入了靠近上界的上界(0.61 $ 0.80 0.61\leq\kappa\leq 0.80)大波段。 在687项(84.2%为84.2%)上达成了一致,在129项(15.8%为15.8 %)上存在分歧。

blocks.en: Three qualifications are in order, and we make them because a κ \kappa in the substantial band is often reported as though it settled the matter. First, κ \kappa is sensitive to the marginal distribution of categories, and a corpus deliberately enriched in positives has a chance agreement of 0.5029 0.5029 rather than the much higher value a naturalistic sample would produce; the coefficient is therefore not comparable to κ \kappa values reported on differently sampled corpora ( Artstein and Poesio, 2008 ) . Second, an aggregate coefficient over three raters conceals pairwise structure. Third, and most informative, the disagreements are not noise. They cluster on exactly the constructions that motivate the resource: reported speech and quotation of misogynistic content, evaluative adjectives applied to a woman where gender may or may not be the ground of the evaluation, and utterances in which a gendered stereotype is invoked ironically. An item such as “Que mulher besta!!” split the annotators two to one, and a reasonable person can defend either reading. These cases are the phenomenon, not a failure to capture it, and their retention with a confidence_label field is a design choice rather than a compromise.
blocks.zh: 3个资格是好的,我们做这些资格,因为一个 = kappa 在实质性的波段中经常被报告为它解决了问题。 首先,ox-kappa对分类的边际分布很敏感,而有意以正数浓缩的物剂的概率协议为0.5029 0.5029, 而不是自然抽样产生的高得多的价值;因此,该系数不能与不同样本的ox-kappa数值相媲美(Artstein and Poesio, 2008)。 第二,三等分数的总系数掩盖了双向结构。 第三,也是最能说明问题的,分歧不是噪音。 它们集中在激励资源的各种概念上:报道的言论和引用厌恶女性的内容,评价形容词适用于可能或可能不是评价依据的妇女,以及讽刺地援引性别定型观念的言论。 “Que mulher besta!”将注释者分成两等一等, 这些情况是现象,不是无法捕捉到,而是用置信来保留_label field是设计选择,而不是妥协.

blocks.en: Disagreements were resolved by majority rule: with three annotations, the label endorsed by at least two prevailed. We follow Trajano et al. (2023) in preferring this to a unanimity requirement, which would bias the positive class toward explicit instances and train models that recognise only the misogyny that announces itself. The corpus records for every instance whether its label was unanimous or majority , which allows any user to reconstruct the strict subset, to weight instances by confidence, or to evaluate models separately on the contested cases. We regard this field as one of the more useful properties of the release and encourage its use.
blocks.zh: 分歧通过多数规则解决:有三个说明,标签得到至少两个赞同。 我们遵循特拉亚诺等人(2023年)的做法,倾向于采用一致要求,这会使积极的阶层偏向于明确的例子,并训练只承认自己宣布的厌恶女性的模式。 案卷记录了每个案例的标签是一致的还是多数的,这使得任何用户都能够重建严格的子集,通过信任来权衡实例,或者对有争议的案件分别评价模型. 我们认为这个领域是释放的更有用的特性之一,并鼓励使用它。

blocks.en: 3.3 Consolidation, Balance and Release
blocks.zh: 3.3 合并、平衡和释放

blocks.en: Preprocessing lowercased the text, replaced URLs, mentions and hashtags with the tokens [URL] , [USER] and [HASHTAG] , normalised laughter variants ( kkkk , rsrsrs , hahaha ) to [LAUGHTER] , removed duplicates and empty strings, and anonymised mentions, e-mail addresses and telephone numbers. Anonymisation was verified after partitioning by sampling with type-specific regular expressions and correcting the residual false positives and negatives by hand.
blocks.zh: 预处理小写了文本,替换了 URL, 引用并标有符号 [URL], [USER]和 [HASHTAG], 正常的笑声变体 (kkkk, rersrs, hahahaha) 到 [LAUGHTER], 移除了重复和空字符串, 以及匿名引用, 电子邮件地址和电话号码. 通过对特定类型正则表达方式进行取样,并通过手工纠正残余的假阳性和阴性,在进行分解后核实了匿名。

blocks.en: After annotation the class distribution stood at 448 misogynistic and 367 non-misogynistic, a 55 55 / 45 45 split. Balance was achieved by drawing 81 further not offensive items from OLID-BR, yielding 448 per class. We flag the terminology because it matters: the additional negatives are new items drawn from an external corpus, not duplicated instances, so no instance appears twice and no leakage across the train/test boundary arises from this step. The final corpus was partitioned by stratified sampling at 80 80 / 20 20 into 716 training and 180 test instances, each partition balanced at 50 50 / 50 50 . The partitions are fixed and released, so every number in Section 5 is reproducible against the same split.
blocks.zh: 经注解后,班级分布为448个反女性和367个非偏女性,55分/45分. 通过从OLID-BR抽取81个非攻击性物品,每班448个,实现了平衡。 我们标出术语,因为它很重要:额外的负数是从外部实体中取出的新项目,而不是重复实例,因此没有实例出现两次,火车/试验边界之间没有渗出。 最终的样本按80 80 / 20 20 至 716次培训和180次试验进行分层取样,每分层平衡为50 / 50 50 个。 分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分

The corpus is distributed as UTF-8 CSV through the Hugging Face Hub under version tag v1.0 , accompanied by a dataset card containing scope, field documentation, citation instructions, licence and ethical notes, in line with the documentation practices argued for by Bender and Friedman (2018) and Gebru et al. blocks.en: 3.4 Characterization
blocks.zh: 3.4 特性

blocks.en: We characterise the corpus with attention to the misogynistic class, since that is what the resource exists to capture. Table 4 reports its length statistics. The distribution is strongly right-skewed, with a mean of 21.41 21.41 tokens against a median of 16 16 and a maximum of 103 103 , reflecting a bimodal discursive reality: short messages consisting of a direct insult, and longer comments that build an argument for the target’s illegitimacy. The two poles are not merely stylistic variants. The short pole is where lexical models perform well and where the phenomenon is least interesting; the long pole is where the corpus earns its purpose and where lexical models fail.
blocks.zh: 我们以对厌恶女性阶级的注意来描述犯罪主体的特征,因为这是现有资源可以捕捉的. 表4报告了长度统计。 发行量极右,平均为21.41个21.41个信使与中位数16个信使,最高为103个103个信使,反映了一种双模式的曲折现实:短信息由直接的侮辱所组成,较长的评论为目标的非法性制造了论据. 两极并不仅仅是形而上学的变体. 短杆是词典模型表现良好,现象最不引人入胜的地方;长杆是词典模型获得目的并失败的地方.

blocks.en: Lexical diversity, measured as the type-token ratio, is 0.298 0.298 over a vocabulary of 2,861 2{,}861 types and 9,592 9{,}592 tokens. This is consistent with the recurrent observation that hate speech corpora exhibit constrained and repetitive vocabularies, driven by the reuse of a stable stock of insults and stereotyped constructions ( Fortuna and Nunes, 2018 ; Vargas et al., 2022 ; Plath et al., 2022 ; Poletto et al., 2021 ) . We report the figure with an explicit caveat that is frequently omitted: TTR is a decreasing function of text length and is therefore not comparable across corpora of different sizes. The value above characterises MISO-BR and licenses no comparison with the diversity reported for larger resources. Studies wishing to compare lexical diversity across corpora should use a length-invariant measure such as MTLD ( McCarthy and Jarvis, 2010 ) .
blocks.zh: 以"打字比"衡量的字形多样性,在2,861个2{,}861个类型和9,592个9{,}592个符号的词汇中为0.298个0.298个. 这符合反复出现的观点,即仇恨言论公司在重新使用稳定的侮辱和定型建筑存量的推动下,呈现出限制和重复的词汇(Fortuna和Nunes,2018;Vargas等,2022;Plath等,2022;Poletto等,2021). 我们报告这一数字时有一个明确的告诫,但经常省略: TTR是文本长度递减的函数,因此不同大小的corpora之间没有可比性. 以上价值的特点为MISO-BR和许可证,与所报告的较大资源的多样性没有可比性。 想要比较整个公司内部的词典多样性的研究应当使用长度变化度量,例如MTLD(McCarthy和Jarvis,2010年)。

blocks.en: Unigram analysis of the misogynistic class is dominated by the anonymisation marker USER , followed by mulher , puta , vagabunda and piranha , a profile in which feminine identity is reduced to stigmas of sexuality and morality. Bigrams show intensification through lexical combination, with filha da puta prominent, and a non-trivial role for emoji pairs, which function to intensify or to ridicule rather than to soften. The high frequency of USER deserves a modelling note: it is an artefact of anonymisation, it correlates with the positive class because attacks are addressed, and any classifier trained on this corpus will exploit it. Removing the token or replacing it with a constant across classes is advisable for any study interested in linguistic rather than structural signal.
blocks.zh: 以无名化标记USER为主, Bigrams通过语法结合表现出强化,有filha da puta突出,以及emoji对子的非三相作用,功能是强化或嘲笑而不是软化. USER的高频率值得一个建模说明:它是匿名的动词,它与正值类相关,因为攻击被处理,任何受过此学分培训的分类者都会利用它。 任何对语言信号而不是结构信号感兴趣的研究,最好取消标志或取而代之。

blocks.en: Qualitative inspection confirms that misogyny in the corpus exceeds direct insult and organises itself into recognisable discursive strategies. Four recur. Sexualisation and harassment reduce the target to a sexual object, often through animalising vocatives. Intellectual disqualification denies competence on gendered grounds, as in the assertion that pregnancy makes women stupid, or in the pathologising vocabulary of louca , doida and desequilibrada applied to a woman raising her voice. Stereotype enforcement polices conduct against a gendered norm, frequently through the diminutive ( mulherzinha ) and through accusations of hypocrisy directed at feminism. Symbolic violence and threat range from calls for physical punishment to explicit endorsement of lethal violence, and are notable for often carrying their own meta-commentary, anticipating and pre-emptively dismissing the charge of misogyny.
blocks.zh: 定性检查证实,人身保护令中的厌恶女性行为超过了直接的侮辱行为,并组织自己采取可辨识的模糊策略。 复有四会. 性化和骚扰往往通过动物化诱导手段,将目标降低到性对象. 智力丧失资格以性别为由剥夺能力,例如,怀孕使妇女变得愚蠢,或者在洛卡的病态词汇中,Doida和desequilibrada适用于提高自己声音的妇女。 陈规定型的执法政策违背性别规范,经常通过Diminutive(mulherzinha)和针对女性主义的伪善指控。 象征性的暴力和威胁从要求体罚到明确认可致命暴力,而且往往表现得十分突出,因为人们往往自以为是,预见并先发制人地驳回对厌恶女性的指控。

blocks.en: The last of these is worth dwelling on, because it exposes what a lexicon cannot reach. An utterance that concludes by dismissing anyone who would call the speaker misogynistic is performing an awareness of the category while committing the act, and no keyword list will separate it from an ironic quotation of the same words. It is instances of this kind that justify a specialised corpus, and it is on instances of this kind that our own annotators disagreed most.
blocks.zh: 最后一个值得关注,因为它揭示出一个词汇所无法达到的。 最后,任何称发言人为厌恶女性者的人在犯下这一行为时都会被辞退,任何关键词清单都无法将其与同样词语的讽刺性引文分开。 正是这类情况才证明专门文书是正当的,正是在这类情况中,我们自己的注释者最不同意。

blocks.en: 4 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 4 实验设置

blocks.en: The task is binary classification of misogynistic against non-misogynistic text over the fixed partitions described in Section 3 . Models were fitted on the training partition only; the test partition was held out from all hyperparameter selection and modelling decisions and used exactly once.
blocks.zh: 任务是在第3节所述的固定分区之上,对反女性文字与非女性文字进行二进制分类。 模型只安装在培训分区上;测试分区从所有超参数选择和建模决定中取出,并精确使用一次。

blocks.en: Four classical baselines were evaluated. Multinomial and Bernoulli Naive Bayes were fitted on word unigram and bigram counts, with the smoothing parameter explored by cross-validation on the training partition. A linear SVM (LinearSVC) and a random forest were fitted on TF-IDF representations of word unigrams and bigrams, with the regularisation parameter and the number and depth of trees respectively tuned by stratified cross-validation on the training partition. These models are included not because they are competitive but because they are the reference points against which the Brazilian literature has reported for a decade ( Pelle and Moreira, 2017 ; Fortuna and Nunes, 2018 ; Trajano et al., 2023 ) , and because their failure modes are diagnostic.
blocks.zh: 评估了四个古典基线。 Bernoulli Naive Bayes被安装在单词和bigram计数上,在训练分区上通过交叉验证探索了平滑参数。 在一个线性SVM(LinearSVC)和一个随机森林被安装在TF-IDF对单词和bigrams的表示上,通过分层交叉验证在训练分区上分别调取正则参数和树的数量和深度. 这些模型之所以列入,不是因为它们具有竞争力,而是因为它们是巴西文献十年来所报道的参照点(Pelle and Moreira, 2017;Fortuna and Nunes, 2018;Trajano等, 2023),还因为它们的失败模式是诊断性的.

blocks.en: Two transformer baselines were evaluated: BERTimbau Base and BERTimbau Large ( Souza et al., 2020 ) , fine-tuned with cased tokenisation, a maximum sequence length between 128 and 256 tokens and AdamW optimisation. The Base variant was trained for up to 20 epochs with a batch size of 16, the Large variant for up to 10 epochs with a batch size of 8 owing to memory requirements. Both used early stopping with patience of 3 on validation macro- F 1 F_{1} . Base stopped at epoch 16 with its best validation score at epoch 13; Large stopped at epoch 8 with its best at epoch 5. Fine-tuning ran on Google Colab with a Tesla T4 GPU (15.8 GB), Python 3.12.12 and Transformers 4.56.1. Random seeds were fixed and library versions recorded.
blocks.zh: 评估了两个变压器基线:BERTimbau Base和BERTimbau Lige(Souza等,2020年),用案证调整,最大序列长度为128至256个令牌和AdamW优化. Base变体被训练到最多20个发相,分批大小为16个;大变体被训练到最多10个发相,分批大小为8个出自内存要求. 两人在验证宏上都用3的耐心提前停止了——F 1 F_{1}. 基地以最佳验证分数止于第16个纪元;以最佳验证分数止于第13个纪元;以最佳验证分数止于第8个纪元. 微调在Google Colab上跑出一款特斯拉T4 GPU (15.8 GB),Python 3.12.12和变形器 4.56.1. 随机种子被固定并记录了库版.

blocks.en: The primary metric is macro- F 1 F_{1} , chosen for comparability with prior work under both balanced and unbalanced conditions ( Fortuna and Nunes, 2018 ; Oliveira et al., 2023 ) . We additionally report accuracy, per-class precision and recall, ROC-AUC and AUC-PR for the positive class. Because the test partition contains 180 items, a single item corresponds to 0.56 0.56 percentage points of accuracy, and we therefore accompany every headline figure with a Wilson 95% confidence interval ( Wilson, 1927 ) and decline to interpret differences that fall inside it ( Dror et al., 2018 ) .
blocks.zh: 主要的衡量标准是宏-F 1 F_{1},在平衡和不平衡的条件下与先前的工作进行比较(Fortuna和Nunes,2018;Oliveira等,2023)。 我们还报告准确性、每级精确度和召回率、ROC-AUC和AUC-PR为正数级。 由于测试分区包含180个项目,单项对应精确度为0.56 0.56个百分点,因此我们随同每条头条数字以威尔逊95%的置信间隔(Wilson,1927)并拒绝解释其内部落下的差异(Dror等,2018年).

blocks.en: Three hypotheses were stated before the experiments. H1: transformer models outperform classical baselines on macro- F 1 F_{1} and AUC-PR. H2: among classical models, the linear SVM with TF-IDF outperforms Naive Bayes and random forest. H3: the difference between BERTimbau Base and Large is small relative to the additional computational cost.
blocks.zh: 实验前陈述了三种假设. H1:变压器模型在宏-F 1 F_{1}和AUC-PR上超过了经典基线. H2: 在古典模型中,带有TF-IDF的线性SVM超越了Naive Bayes和随机森林. H3:BERTimbau Base和Large的相差小于额外的计算成本.

blocks.en: 5 Results and Discussion
blocks.zh: 5 结果和讨论

blocks.en: Table 5 reports the classical baselines. The random forest with TF-IDF attains the highest macro- F 1 F_{1} ( 0.676 0.676 ) and accuracy ( 0.678 0.678 ), the linear SVM the highest ROC-AUC ( 0.747 0.747 ), and Multinomial Naive Bayes the highest precision ( 0.760 0.760 ) at the lowest recall ( 0.500 0.500 ). We do not rank these models. The full range of accuracies spans 0.656 0.656 to 0.678 0.678 , which is four test items, and the confidence intervals overlap almost completely. H2 is therefore neither confirmed nor refuted: the experiment as designed cannot distinguish a linear SVM from a random forest from a Naive Bayes classifier on this corpus, and reporting the random forest as “best” would be an artefact of reading a point estimate as though it were a measurement. What can be said is that TF-IDF representations appear at least as good as bag-of-words counts, that all four models cluster around 0.66 0.66 to 0.68 0.68 macro- F 1 F_{1} , and that a larger test partition would be required to say more.

blocks.en: Table 6 reports the transformer baselines. Both variants reach a test macro- F 1 F_{1} of 0.833 0.833 and, notably, produce identical confusion matrices: 76 true negatives, 14 false positives, 16 false negatives and 74 true positives, for an accuracy of 150 / 180 = 0.833 150/180=0.833 with a Wilson 95% CI of [ 0.772 , 0.881 ] [0.772,0.881] . Precision on the misogynistic class is 0.841 0.841 and recall 0.822 0.822 . blocks.en: The comparison between Base and Large is more interesting for what it forecloses. The two models have the same macro- F 1 F_{1} and the same aggregate confusion matrix, so no paired test can separate them: because both make the same number of errors on the same 180 items, the items that only Base misclassifies and the items that only Large misclassifies are necessarily equal in number, and the McNemar statistic ( McNemar, 1947 ) is zero whatever the per-item predictions. The Large variant holds a marginal advantage in the threshold-free metrics, + 0.011 +0.011 ROC-AUC and + 0.009 +0.009 AUC-PR, which suggests slightly better calibrated ranking without any effect on the decisions actually taken at the operating threshold. Against this, it costs 22.22 22.22 minutes of training against 8.49 8.49 , a factor of 2.6 2.6 , with a correspondingly slower inference. H3 is supported, and the practical recommendation is unambiguous: on a corpus of this size the Base variant is the rational choice, and the capacity of the Large variant is idle because the training signal is too small to use it.
blocks.zh: Base和Large的比较比较比较有趣,因为它可以赎回什么. 这两个模型有相同的宏-F 1 F_{1}和相同的集合混淆矩阵,所以没有一对的测试可以将它们分开:因为两个模型都在同一180个项目上产生相同的出错次数,只有Base错误分类的项目和只有Lige错误分类的项目在数量上必然是等同的,无论每个项目的预测结果如何,麦克内马尔统计(McNemar,1947年)都是零. 大变体在无门槛度量中占据了边际优势,+0.011+0.011 ROC-AUC和+0.009+0.009 AUC-PR,这表明对运行阈值上实际做出的决定略作校正,没有产生任何影响. 与此相反,培训花费22.22分22.22分,而培训时间为8.49分8.49分,系数为2.6 2.6分,推论相应缓慢。 H3得到支持,而实用建议也毫不含糊地表示:在这个大小的集合上,Base变体是理性的选择,而大变体的能力被闲置了,因为训练信号太小,无法使用.

blocks.en: Three qualifications attach to the figure of 0.833 0.833 before it can be used for anything: what it predicts about deployment, what part of it may not be measuring misogyny at all, and what it would have been under a different resolution rule. The first is prevalence. A macro- F 1 F_{1} of 0.833 0.833 on a balanced test set is a reasonable result for a corpus of 716 training instances and a poor predictor of behaviour in deployment, because MISO-BR is balanced at 50 % 50\% positives by construction while the base rate of misogynistic content in an unfiltered stream is far lower. Precision is a function of that base rate, and the function is unforgiving. Take the observed operating point of BERTimbau Base: true positive rate 74 / 90 = 0.822 74/90=0.822 , false positive rate 14 / 90 = 0.156 14/90=0.156 . Holding these fixed and varying the prevalence π \pi , precision is Precision ​ ( π ) = π ⋅ 0.822 π ⋅ 0.822 + ( 1 − π ) ⋅ 0.156 . \text{Precision}(\pi)=\frac{\pi\cdot 0.822}{\pi\cdot 0.822+(1-\pi)\cdot 0.156}. At π = 0.5 \pi=0.5 this returns the observed 0.84 0.84 . At π = 0.05 \pi=0.05 , a generous estimate for a stream of replies to a public figure, it returns 0.22 0.22 . At π = 0.01 \pi=0.01 it returns 0.05 0.05 : nineteen of every twenty flags would be false. The model has not become worse; the metric was never measuring what a deployment cares about. This is not a defect peculiar to MISO-BR, and it is not an argument against balancing, which is defensible for a corpus of this size where an unbalanced split would leave too few positives to learn from. It is an argument for stating the consequence explicitly rather than allowing a balanced macro- F 1 F_{1} to circulate as a deployment claim. Anyone building a moderation system from this corpus must calibrate the threshold against the prevalence of their own stream, must expect the false positive rate to dominate, and should treat a 0.156 0.156 FPR as the number to reduce.
blocks.zh: 3个资格附加在0.833 0.833的数字后,才能用于任何用途:它预测的部署情况,其中哪些部分可能根本不是衡量反女性现象,以及它在不同的解析规则下会有什么. 第一是流行现象。 在一个均衡的测试集上,一个0.833 0.833的宏F 1 F_{1}是716个培训实例的合理结果,对部署中的行为的预测能力也差,因为MISO-BR通过建筑平衡为50%-50\%正值,而未过滤流中厌恶女性内容的基准率要低得多。 精度是该基率的一个函数,该函数是不可原谅的. 取BERTIMBAU基地的观测操作点:真实正率为74/90=0.822 74/90=0.822,假正率为14/90=0.156 14/90=0.156. 持有这些固定且变化的流行性 \\ pi,精度是 = = = 0.822 + ( 1 − ) 0. 822 + ( 1 − ) 0. 156 。\ text{ 精度} (\ pi)\ frac\ pi\ cdot 0. 822\ (1-\ pi)\ cdot 0.156}。 在 = 0.5\pi= 0.5 时,返回观测到的 0.84 0.84 。 = 0.05\pi=0.05 对公众数字的答复流的慷慨估计,它返回0.22 0.22。 =0.01\pi=0.01 它返回0.050.05:每20个旗帜中有19个是假的。 这一模式没有恶化;衡量尺度从来不是衡量部署所关心的是什么。 这不是MISO-BR的特有缺陷,也不是反对平衡的论点,对于这种规模庞大、不平衡的分裂会留下太少的好东西无法从中吸取教训的机构来说,平衡是站得住脚的。 之所以要明确说明后果,而不是允许平衡的宏观-F 1 F_{1}作为部署主张流通,是站不住脚的。 任何从这个机构建立温和制度的人,必须校正其自身流的流行程度的门槛,必须期望假正率占上风,并且应将0.156 0.156 降温作为减少数字。

blocks.en: The second qualification concerns provenance. Roughly 60 % 60\% of the corpus derives from OLID-BR and roughly 40 % 40\% from scraping, and this split is not orthogonal to the label. The scraped portion was collected using misogyny lexicons and therefore contributes disproportionately to the positive class; the OLID-BR portion contributes the not offensive items, including all 81 of the balancing top-up, and therefore disproportionately to the negative class. A classifier can reduce its loss by learning to discriminate scraped-tweet register from OLID-BR register, and to the extent that it does so, part of the 0.833 0.833 is measuring provenance rather than misogyny. We do not know how large that part is, and we say so. We also make it measurable: the source field is released precisely so that this can be quantified, and we recommend three checks to anyone using the corpus for modelling claims. Train on the corpus and evaluate on the scraped subset alone and the OLID-BR subset alone, and compare. Train a classifier to predict source from text and inspect its accuracy; anything well above chance quantifies the confound directly. Evaluate on the unanimous and majority subsets separately, since the confound and the difficulty are likely correlated. Version 2 of the corpus should be sourced so that provenance and label are independent, which chiefly means annotating enough scraped negatives to make the OLID-BR top-up unnecessary.
blocks.zh: 第二项资格涉及出处。 大约60%的血清来源于OLID-BR,大约40%的40分来源于刮取,这种分解不是正统的。 被刮去的部分是使用厌恶女性的词汇来收集的,因此对正数级的贡献过大;OLID-BR部分贡献了非攻击性项目,包括平衡上调的所有81个,因此对负数级的贡献过大. 一个分类员可以通过学习从OLID-BR登记册中区分被刮去的tweet登记册来减少损失,只要这样做,0.833 0.833的一部分是测量出处而不是厌恶女性。 我们不知道这部分有多大,我们这样说。 我们也使它可以衡量:源字段是准确的释放出来的,以便可以量化,我们建议任何人使用该元件进行模拟索赔。 单独对被刮掉的子集和OLID-BR子集进行测试和比较。 训练一个分类员从文本中预测出源并检查其准确性;任何远高于概率的事物都会直接将混乱者量化. 分别评估一致和多数子集,因为混乱和困难可能相互关联。 第2版的书目来源应使出处和标签具有独立性,这主要意味着要注明足够被刮去的底片,使OLID-BR上架没有必要。

blocks.en: The third qualification runs in the opposite direction. Where provenance may inflate the headline figure, the resolution rule deflates it. The 129 129 disagreements, 15.8 % 15.8\% of annotated items, are in our view the most informative part of the resource, and they are not distributed randomly: they concentrate on reported speech, on evaluative predicates whose gendered grounding is arguable, and on irony. These are the constructions on which any deployed system will be contested, and on which the classical baselines fail almost completely. Retaining them under majority rule with a recorded confidence_label , rather than discarding them or requiring unanimity, follows Trajano et al. (2023) and is consequential. Requiring unanimity would have produced a corpus of 687 687 items whose positive class was systematically more explicit, on which every model would have scored higher, and from which every model would have learned less. The reported 0.833 0.833 is therefore lower than it would have been under a stricter rule.
blocks.zh: 第三个资格是相反的。 如果来源可能使头条数字膨胀,则决议规则会使其膨胀. 我们认为,129项分歧,即15.8%的注解项目,是资源中信息最丰富的部分,它们不是随机分布的:它们集中于报告的言论、其性别理由可以论证的评价前提和讽刺。 这些都是任何部署的系统都将受到质疑的构筑物,而古典的基线几乎完全失效。 因此,在特拉亚诺等人(2023年)之后,用有记录的信任——标签——保留他们,而不是抛弃他们或要求一致同意。 要求一致同意本来可以产生一套687 687件物品,其正面等级有系统地更加明确,每个模型的得分会更高,每个模型的得分会更少。 因此,所报告的0.833 0.833低于更严格的规则。

blocks.en: One comparison remains, and we do not draw it. The reported baseline for MINA-BR is F 1 = 0.57 F_{1}=0.57 for SVM ( Plath et al., 2022 ) , against 0.671 0.671 for our linear SVM and 0.833 0.833 for BERTimbau Base, and it would be straightforward, and wrong, to present this as evidence that MISO-BR supports better models. The two corpora differ in class balance, in sampling strategy, in platform composition, in annotation guideline, in annotator panel, in label definition and in test partition. A difference in F 1 F_{1} across corpora measures the joint effect of all of these and isolates none. More concretely, MISO-BR is balanced by construction and MINA-BR is not; F 1 F_{1} on the positive class is a function of prevalence, as the calculation above makes plain, so the two figures are not on a common scale. The experiment that would license a comparison, evaluating the same model on both corpora or transferring a model trained on one to the other, has become feasible now that the MINA-BR data are public ( Plath et al., 2025 ) ; we have not run it, and it is the most immediate follow-up to this work. We therefore report the MINA-BR figure for context and make no claim of superiority.
blocks.zh: 一种比较仍然存在,我们没有进行这种比较。 据报MINA-BR的基准SVM(Plath等,2022年)为F 1 = 0.57 F_{1}=0.57;我们的线性SVM为0.671 0.671;BERTimbau Base为0.833 0.833。 提出这一点作为MISO-BR支持更好的模型的证据是直接和错误的。 两种蝎子在分类平衡,采样策略,平台组成,注释准则,注释面板,标签定义和测试分块上都有所不同. F 1 FQQQ 1} 公司内部的区别 测量所有这些的连带效应 并隔离无一。 更具体地说,MISO-BR被建筑所平衡,而MINA-BR则不是;正类上F 1 F_{1}是流行性的函数,因为上面的计算是明了的,所以这两个数字并不是在共同的尺度上. 由于MINA-BR数据是公开的(Plath等人,2025年),因此可以进行比较的试验,在公司内部评估同一模型或将一个模型转让给另一个模型。 因此,我们报告MINA-BR数字的背景,不声称优越。

blocks.en: For practitioners, three findings transfer. The transformer gap is large, roughly 16 macro- F 1 F_{1} points, with the larger share of the gain in recall on the misogynistic class; none of the lexical baselines exceeded 0.60 0.60 recall on this corpus. Model capacity beyond BERTimbau Base is not usable at this data scale, since the Large variant costs 2.6 × 2.6\times the training time for a difference indistinguishable from zero. And the [USER] token is a structural artefact correlated with the positive class that should be neutralised in any study interested in linguistic signal.
blocks.zh: 对从业人员来说,有三个结果转移。 变压器间隙较大,大约为16个宏-F 1 F_{1}分数,在反女性类的召回中收益的比重较大;在这个物证上,没有一个字法基线超过0.60 0.60回想. 超出BERTimbau Base的模型容量在此数据尺度上无法使用,因为"大变体"花费了2.6× 2.6\的训练时间,以区别于"零"的区别. 而[USER]符号是一个结构动能,它与任何对语言信号感兴趣的研究中应该中和的正类相关.

blocks.en: 6 Limitations and Threats to Validity
blocks.zh: 6 对有效性的限制和威胁

blocks.en: We group the limitations by the validity they threaten.
blocks.zh: 我们以它们威胁的有效性来划分限制。

blocks.en: Construct validity is threatened primarily by the triage stage, which may systematically favour explicit hostility and under-represent subtle, ironic or contextual misogyny. The 259 discarded items were not audited, so the false negative rate of triage is unmeasured, and the corpus therefore under-represents whatever gemini-2.5-flash does not recognise. A related threat comes from the annotator panel: three annotators, one of them a woman, is a minimal rather than an adequate basis for defining what counts as misogyny, and Zeinert et al. (2021) give reason to expect that a differently composed panel would draw the boundary differently. Finally, collapsing the three-way Neutral / Toxic / Misogynistic distinction into a binary label discards the information that separates gendered from non-gendered hostility, which is arguably the most interesting distinction the guide encodes.
blocks.zh: 建构有效性主要受到分门别类阶段的威胁,这种阶段可能系统性地支持明显的敌意和缺乏代表性的微妙、讽刺或背景上的厌恶。 259个被丢弃的物品没有经过审计,因此没有计量假的负面分解率,因此,无论什么基因组2.5-闪光线都未识别出,体征都不够。 一个相关的威胁来自注释小组:3名注释员,其中1名是妇女,是界定什么是厌恶女性的最低限度而非充分的基础,Zeinert等人(2021年)则说明有理由期望由不同构成的注释小组以不同方式划定边界。 最后,将 " 三向中立 " / " 有毒 " / " 偏执 " 区分 " 二进制标签 " ,抛弃了将性别与非性别敌意区分开来的信息,这可以说是指南编码中最有趣的区分。

blocks.en: Internal validity is threatened by the provenance confound described in Section 5 , by the choice of triage prompt, model and thresholds, which shaped the pool sent to annotation and whose sensitivity was not explored, and by the fact that the balancing top-up drew all 81 additional negatives from a single external source. Hyperparameter selection was performed on the training partition and the test partition was used once, which protects against the most common form of optimism, but the test partition is small enough that its idiosyncrasies are consequential.
blocks.zh: 内部有效性受到第5节所描述的出处混乱的威胁,受到以下因素的威胁:选择分解即时、模型和阈值,这种分解决定了寄给注解的池,没有探讨其敏感性;平衡上加法从单一外部来源抽取了所有81个额外的负数。 在训练分区上进行了超参数选择,测试分区曾被使用过一次,这可以抵御最常见的乐观形式,但测试分区足够小,以至于其特异性因此产生.

blocks.en: External validity is threatened by the single platform, single language variety and single collection window, by the lexicon- and target-guided sampling that departs by design from natural prevalence ( Wiegand et al., 2019 ) , and by the artificial class balance whose effect on precision we quantified above. MISO-BR supports research on the linguistic characterisation of Brazilian Portuguese misogyny and on comparative modelling under a fixed protocol. It does not support estimates of prevalence, claims about platforms other than X, or claims about model performance in deployment.
blocks.zh: 外部有效性受到以下因素的威胁:单一平台、单一语言种类和单一收集窗口、设计偏离自然流行程度的词汇和定向指导抽样(Wiegand等,2019年),以及人工分类平衡,它们对精确性的影响,我们在上面量化。 MISO-BR支持对巴西葡萄牙语语言特征的厌恶和固定协议下的比较建模的研究. 它不支持对流行程度的估计、对X以外平台的声称,或对部署中的模型性能的声称。

blocks.en: Statistical conclusion validity is bounded by the test partition of 180 items. Differences below roughly 7 accuracy points are not distinguishable at this sample size, which is why we ranked no classical model and separated no BERTimbau variant. Any future work reporting improvements on MISO-BR should report confidence intervals or paired significance tests and should treat sub-point gains as noise ( Dror et al., 2018 ) .
blocks.zh: 统计结论有效性以180个物品的试验分区为界. 大约7个精确点以下的差异在这个样本大小上是无法区分的,这就是为什么我们没有排名古典模型,也没有分离出BERTIMBAU变体. 今后报告MISO-BR改进情况的任何工作都应报告置信间隔或成对意义测试,并应将分点收益视为噪音(Dror等人,2018年)。

blocks.en: Finally, and encompassing all of the above, the volume of 896 instances bounds what the corpus can support. It is adequate for fine-tuning a pre-trained Portuguese encoder, as the results show, and it is inadequate for training from scratch, for multiclass or multilabel extension, for meaningful subgroup analysis, or for functional testing of the kind advocated by Röttger et al. (2021) . We present MISO-BR as a documented starting point with a protocol that can be scaled, not as a benchmark of record.
blocks.zh: 最后,包括上述所有内容,896个案例的数量决定了本文书能够支持什么。 如结果所示,它足以微调经过预先培训的葡萄牙编码器,不足以从零开始培训、多级或多标签扩展、有意义的分组分析或Röttger等人(2021年)所提倡的那种功能测试。 我们把MISO-BR作为一个有文件记载的起点,以一个可以缩放的协议,而不是记录的基准。

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en: This paper introduced MISO-BR, an openly available corpus dedicated specifically to misogyny detection in Brazilian Portuguese and released together with its full construction pipeline. It comprises 896 balanced instances collected from X by lexicon- and target-guided scraping and supplemented from OLID-BR, triaged by a documented large language model stage, and annotated by three trained annotators under a published guide, reaching a Fleiss’ κ \kappa of 0.788 0.788 with 89.5 % 89.5\% observed agreement. Baselines span classical models clustering around 0.66 0.66 to 0.68 0.68 macro- F 1 F_{1} and fine-tuned BERTimbau variants reaching 0.833 0.833 , with the Base variant matching the Large at 2.6 × 2.6\times less training cost.
blocks.zh: 本文介绍了MISO-BR,这是一份公开发行的专为巴西葡萄牙语的反女性检测而发行的书目,连同其完整的建筑管道一起发行. 它由896个均衡的实例组成,这些实例是通过词汇和定向取材来收集的,并补充了OLID-BR,通过一个有记录的大型语言模型阶段来补充,并由三位经过培训的注释员在一份已出版的指南下作注释,达成了Fleiss 0.788 0.788 o克appa ,89.5%的观测协议。 基线跨度为古典模型集群约0.66 0.66至0.68 0.68 macro-F 1 F_{1}并微调了BERTimbau的变体,达到0.833 0.833 ;而Base变体则以2.6× 2.6分次相匹配,减了培训费用。

blocks.en: The contribution is not the score. It is a resource in which every step from collection to release is inspectable, in which the label of every instance can be traced to its provenance and to the confidence with which annotators assigned it, and whose known weaknesses have been named and made measurable rather than smoothed over. Specialised resources for Brazilian Portuguese misogyny detection have only recently started to become available to researchers outside the groups that built them. MISO-BR is open from its first version, and it is accompanied by the baselines, the protocol and the partitions against which any successor can be measured, including a cross-corpus evaluation against MINA-BR.
blocks.zh: 贡献不是分数。 它是一种可以检查从收集到发布的每一步骤的资源,在这种资源中,每个实例的标签都可以追溯到其出处和注释者给予它的信任,其已知的弱点被点出并可以衡量,而不是被平平。 巴西葡萄牙人厌恶女性的检测专门资源直到最近才开始提供给建立这些资源的群体以外的研究人员。 MISO-BR从第一个版本开始开放,并附有基线、协议和分区,可据以衡量任何接班人,包括对照MINA-BR进行跨公司评价。

blocks.en: Four directions follow. The corpus should be expanded across platforms, time windows and topical domains, with sourcing designed so that provenance is independent of label. The annotation should be enriched with the multilevel structure the guide already implies, recovering the three-way distinction, adding severity, target and discursive strategy, and adding span-level annotation to support interpretability. The triage stage should be audited by re-annotating a random sample of discarded items, which would convert the pipeline’s recall from an unknown into a measured quantity. And robustness and fairness should be evaluated directly, through functional tests, calibration analysis, obfuscation resistance and cross-platform transfer, rather than inferred from an aggregate score on a balanced split.
blocks.zh: 后入四通所行. 这套文书应扩展到平台、时间窗口和专题领域,并设计来源,使来源独立于标签。 说明应当以指南已经包含的多层次结构来充实,恢复三相区分,增加严重程度、目标和偏差战略,并增加跨级说明以支持可解释性。 应通过重新标注被丢弃物品的随机样本对分拣阶段进行审计,将输油管的召回量从未知量转换为量度量。 而稳健性和公平性应通过功能测试,校正分析,防模糊和跨平台转移等直接评价,而不是从平衡分数上的总分来推断.

blocks.en: Ethics Statement
blocks.zh: 道德操守说明

blocks.en: The corpus consists of publicly posted social media content collected without interaction with users. All texts were normalised and anonymised, with mentions, e-mail addresses, telephone numbers and URLs replaced by generic tokens, and anonymisation was verified by sampling after partitioning. No user identifiers, profile metadata or conversation threads are released. The corpus contains material that is offensive by construction and is distributed for research on the detection and mitigation of gendered hostility; the dataset card states this scope and the conditions of use.
blocks.zh: 其内容包括公开张贴的社交媒体内容,没有与用户互动。 所有文本都实现了正常化和匿名,并附有参考资料、电子邮件地址、电话号码和URL,取而代之的是通用代号,在分区后通过取样核实了匿名。 没有发布用户标识符,配置元数据或对话线索. 这份文书中包含一些材料,这些材料因建筑而具有攻击性,并分发以研究如何发现和减轻性别敌意;数据集卡片说明了这一范围和使用条件。

blocks.en: Annotators were informed of the nature of the material before consenting to participate, received an orientation session, and worked at their own pace. We note, for those replicating this protocol, that sustained exposure to misogynistic content imposes a real burden on annotators, that this burden is not distributed evenly across a panel, and that a female annotator reading attacks on women is not doing the same work as her colleagues.
blocks.zh: 说明员在同意参与之前被告知了材料的性质,接受了情况介绍,并按自己的进度工作。 对于复制这项议定书的人来说,我们注意到,持续暴露于厌恶女性的内容给注释者带来了真正的负担,这种负担在小组中分配不均,一位女性注释者读取对妇女进行的攻击,与其同事的工作不同。

blocks.en: Systems trained on this corpus can cause harm if deployed as automatic moderators. The precision analysis in Section 5 shows that a model performing at 0.84 0.84 precision on the balanced test set would fall to roughly 0.22 0.22 at a 5 % 5\% base rate. We therefore recommend that any application of this resource operate as decision support for human moderators rather than autonomously, and that thresholds be calibrated against the prevalence of the target stream.
blocks.zh: 如果部署作为自动主持人,接受过有关这种人身保护的系统可能会造成伤害。 第5节的精度分析显示,在平衡测试机组上以0.84 0.84精度完成的模型,按5%的5%的基准率,将降至大约0.22 0.22。 因此,我们建议,这种资源的任何应用都应作为对人类主持人的决策支持,而不是自主操作,并根据目标流的流行程度来调整阈值。

blocks.en: Data and Code Availability
blocks.zh: 数据和代码可用性

blocks.en: The corpus is available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/fabiopassos/miso-br under version tag v1.0 , with a dataset card documenting scope, fields, licence, citation and ethical notes. It loads through the Hugging Face datasets library with the revision argument pinned to v1.0 , which is the revision used for every experiment reported here. The annotation guide is available at https://fasp-school.github.io/nlp-misoginia/ . The triage prompt, fine-tuned models and experimental scripts are released alongside the corpus.
blocks.zh: 教程见https://huggingface.co/datasets/fabiopassos/miso-br。 在版本标签v1.0下,有数据集卡记录范围,字段,许可,引用和伦理说明. 它通过 Hugging Face 数据集库加载被钉入 v1.0 的修订参数, 即用于本文中每个实验的修订版 。 注释指南见https://fasp-school.github.io/nlp-misoginia/.。 分解迅速,精细的模型和实验脚本与被体同时发布.
